lock_mode_before_unlock.meaning: the pool's lockMode value set by the Guardian to 3 before any unlockPool work

caller_is_guardian.meaning: whether the caller performing the unlockPool work is the Guardian

unlock_pool_performed.meaning: whether the work of unlockPool (clearing lockMode) was performed

pool_exposed_to_continual_attack.meaning: whether the pool is exposed to continual attack that the Guardian's lockMode=3 setting tried to prevent

assumptions: The unlockPool work clears lockMode, as stated in the intent source.

unresolved.description: The impact's 'continual attack' exposure is a qualitative downstream consequence; the report gives no observable state/value relation linking the unauthorized unlock to that exposure beyond the lockMode=3 setting, so V cannot be tied to the authorization guard without inventing a relation.

limitations: The authorization guard formalizes the intent that only the Guardian may perform unlockPool; the selected impact's continual-attack exposure is recorded as a qualitative Boolean and is not derived from the guard relation.
Report does not state who calls rebaseOraclePack or whether it is permissionless.
